path.data-label: Not yet met: On a Schwinn 800IC the app says once, at connect, that this trainer's resistance is set by hand.
path.title: Not yet met: On a Schwinn 800IC the app says once, at connect, that this trainer's resistance is set by hand.

path.data-label: Not yet met: On a data-only trainer the HR-Zone row reads `TARGET n W` with the deviation arrow and delta beside it, and never the applied styling or its glyph, on either platform. **Reworded 2026-09-17**: it used to require a suggestion word, which [[TASK-0877-TheHrZonePillDropsTheWord]] removed from Android and [[TASK-0935-TheIosHrZoneRowGetsTheSharedReadout]] then removed from iOS. The clause that matters — never the applied styling — is unchanged, because that is the honesty this phase exists for.
path.title: Not yet met: On a data-only trainer the HR-Zone row reads `TARGET n W` with the deviation arrow and delta beside it, and never the applied styling or its glyph, on either platform. **Reworded 2026-09-17**: it used to require a suggestion word, which [[TASK-0877-TheHrZonePillDropsTheWord]] removed from Android and [[TASK-0935-TheIosHrZoneRowGetsTheSharedReadout]] then removed from iOS. The clause that matters — never the applied styling — is unchanged, because that is the honesty this phase exists for.

path.data-label: Not yet met: A target or a cue is visible in all three ride modes — Power, HR-Zone and Route — on a data-only trainer.
path.title: Not yet met: A target or a cue is visible in all three ride modes — Power, HR-Zone and Route — on a data-only trainer.

path.data-label: Not yet met: Control writes stop once a trainer is known data-only, and the diagnostics log records why they stopped.
path.title: Not yet met: Control writes stop once a trainer is known data-only, and the diagnostics log records why they stopped.

path.data-label: Not yet met: The Schwinn 800IC is on the public compatibility list in a data-only bucket, published from the sibling repo in all nine locale copies, and both shipped parsers render that bucket rather than treating it as *not listed*.
path.title: Not yet met: The Schwinn 800IC is on the public compatibility list in a data-only bucket, published from the sibling repo in all nine locale copies, and both shipped parsers render that bucket rather than treating it as *not listed*.

path.data-label: Not yet met: A 40-minute ride on the 800IC produces a diagnostics export that still contains its connect-time block, including the 0x2ACC bits and the Indoor Bike Data flags word.
path.title: Not yet met: A 40-minute ride on the 800IC produces a diagnostics export that still contains its connect-time block, including the 0x2ACC bits and the Indoor Bike Data flags word.

path.data-label: Not yet met: Field evidence is sought: an internal-testing build is offered to Paul Evans with a ride in each mode requested; his reply, or its absence after the offer, is recorded on ISS-0405. Not gated on his answer.
path.title: Not yet met: Field evidence is sought: an internal-testing build is offered to Paul Evans with a ride in each mode requested; his reply, or its absence after the offer, is recorded on ISS-0405. Not gated on his answer.

path.data-label: Not yet met: `PARITY_MATRIX` carries a row for every surface this phase adds or alters, and the parity gallery gains keys for the data-only and pacer-on states of the route, route-map, free-ride SIM, Power and HR-Zone cockpits.
path.title: Not yet met: `PARITY_MATRIX` carries a row for every surface this phase adds or alters, and the parity gallery gains keys for the data-only and pacer-on states of the route, route-map, free-ride SIM, Power and HR-Zone cockpits.

path.data-label: Not yet met: The rider manual in the sibling repo has pages for riding a bike the app cannot control and for the pacer ghost, in English and the eight locale copies, passing the translation-parity check.
path.title: Not yet met: The rider manual in the sibling repo has pages for riding a bike the app cannot control and for the pacer ghost, in English and the eight locale copies, passing the translation-parity check.
